instructions: Pick the cheapest Claude model that can reliably complete this delegated task. Prefer cheaper models unless the task clearly needs more capability.

candidates.criteria: Lookups, file/code search, listing or summarizing, trivial single-line edits, simple questions.
Typical coding: implement a function or small feature, write tests, fix an ordinary bug, routine refactor.
Complex multi-file changes, tricky debugging, subtle concurrency or performance issues, careful code review.
Hardest problems only: deep reasoning, large system or architecture design, novel algorithms, high-stakes plans.
